thread:
Aisha Khan: :rotating_light: alerts spiking for inference-api canary in eu-west-1 — 5xx increased from 0.3% -> ~12% in last 2m, latency p95 shot up. noticing crashloops on 3 pods.
OncallBot: Paging @Alex Chen — oncall for infra.
Alex Chen: I got it, joining. any deploy id?
DeployBot: Canary deploy started: deploy-2026-03-15-17:02-eu-west1 (commit f6a2b4). Canary size: 5 pods.
Aisha Khan: yes that deploy. Root cause suspected during rollout. can confirm the failing pods are the new image.
Alex Chen: checking kubectl logs now.
Alex Chen: logs from inference-frontend-5b7d: "failed to bind to address ::1:8000: address already in use" then liveness probe failing, container restarts.
Jon Peterson: hmm we switched on dual-stack networking flag in the manifest for this rollout (beta). could be binding to IPv6 loopback while probe hits IPv4.
Maria Gutierrez: Customer Ops: getting customer reports of API errors when region=eu-west in headers. some retries succeed.
Alex Chen: also seeing HPA scaling weirdly — minReplicas set to 0 in canary config by mistake? HPA shows min 0 for the canary target, so when nodes drained it scaled to 0 then started crashloop when rescheduled.
Aisha Khan: Impact estimate? how many requests failed?
Customer Ops Bot: Recent error sampling: ~1.2k 5xx in last 3m for eu-west-1 endpoints. Affected: web-hooks and inference API customers.
Jon Peterson: can we flip feature-flag for dual-stack off for this rollout?
Alex Chen: I'm going to pause the rollout and force rollback if kill-switch exists.
DeployBot: Canary paused by alexc.
Alex Chen: Trying kill-switch: calling /feature-flags/rollout/disable?flag=network-dualstack&target=canary
Alex Chen: API returns 200. Flag disabled for canary subset.
Aisha Khan: :thumbsup: any immediate change in pod behavior?
Alex Chen: rolling restart of affected pods now (kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-frontend-canary).
Alex Chen: pods come up but still complaining about binding on ::1, probes still fail on some nodes.
Jon Peterson: looks like the container image also dropped an init container that expects a configmap key IPV6_MODE. that key missing -> process falls back to IPv6-only bind. that explains mismatch.
Maria Gutierrez: Customer Ops: telling CS to open postmortem tickets for customers who saw 5xx. Collecting list.
Aisha Khan: I'm going to trigger rollback to previous stable image. deploy-bot, initiate rollback for deploy-2026-03-15-17:02-eu-west1.
DeployBot: Rollback initiated by alexc -> target image tag stable-20260314. Canary size scaled down, previous ReplicaSet reconverging.
OncallBot: Handoff note: Alex is primary, Jon on networking, Maria on customer comms. Paging resumed to ensure no new regressions.
Alex Chen: rolling back succeeded, new pods from stable image are green, liveness/readiness ok. p95 latency back to baseline.
Aisha Khan: HPA misconfig: we'll revert canary manifest change setting minReplicas=1 and remove dual-stack flag until we validate in staging. create an action item.
Jon Peterson: opened infra ticket INFRA-4862: revert dual-stack flag from canary pipeline and add automated probe tests for IPv4/IPv6 parity.
Maria Gutierrez: Customer Ops: sent initial notice to affected customers, offering timeline and a follow-up incident email.
Aisha Khan: root cause summary so far: 1) canary manifest introduced dual-stack networking + removed required config key -> container bound to IPv6 only; 2) canary HPA manifest mistakenly set minReplicas to 0 causing scale-to-zero edge during node churn; 3) probes didn't cover IPv4 binding, so crashloops triggered.
Alex Chen: mitigation steps taken: disabled dual-stack flag for canary, rolled back to stable image, scaled minReplicas back to 1 in HPA, added temporary node-affinity to avoid nodes under maintenance.
Aisha Khan: ETA for postmortem?
Jon Peterson: I'll own the tech writeup, aiming for initial draft in 24h. Maria will add customer impact notes.
Maria Gutierrez: Customer Ops will prepare incident email draft and share in #general for approvals.
Alex Chen: monitoring: setting a temporary alert to catch binding errors and minReplicas=0 on canary targets.
Aisha Khan: great. closing incident once monitoring is stable and customer comms sent. thanks everyone. :heart:
DeployBot: Canary rollback completed at 2376543340.
OncallBot: Incident resolved by alexc — marking as resolved in pagerduty.
Maria Gutierrez: will attach logs and pod dumps to the ticket before handoff.
Jon Peterson: adding note: add automated canary teardown if any essential config keys missing in future.
Aisha Khan: good call. postmortem checklist assigned.
